events.observed_signal: The first public-search diagnostic used broad case-insensitive CAPTCHA and login phrases, so ordinary application-shell copy could be mistaken for a confirmed challenge or required-login boundary.

correction.action: Replaced the broad interpretation with exact challenge markers and stable-identity/structured-state checks; the sanitized evidence explicitly records no confirmed challenge.

events.schema_impact: No shared schema changed; the P54 evidence shape now distinguishes confirmed challenges from generic page text.
events.quality_impact: Prevents a false access-boundary label while preserving the zero-identity external blocker.

learning.reusable_lesson: A login link or verification vocabulary in an application shell is not evidence of an active challenge.
learning.future_prevention: Classify access boundaries only from exact retained markers or visible challenge state, and report application shells separately.

events.observed_signal: Appending the authorized TikTok registration first failed exact implementation composition; composing both implementations then failed the adapter-registry fingerprint pinned by immutable YouTube manifest KU2D-RM-000001-V001.

correction.action: Reverted the attempted adapter, manifests and registry row, preserved exact deterministic failure evidence, restored the original registry and Foundation regression, and stopped before protected-file modification.

events.schema_impact: The new Scope Declaration v1 contract remains valid; no protected P53 runtime, registry schema or immutable manifest was changed.
events.quality_impact: Frozen YouTube execution remains green; TikTok MTC and adapter registration remain correctly withheld.

learning.reusable_lesson: A content-addressed singleton adapter registry cannot evolve additively while historical manifests pin the singleton path and full-document fingerprint.
learning.future_prevention: Design versioned registry snapshots or an explicitly authorized backward-compatible registry migration before the next source adapter is registered.

events.observed_signal: The first Level 3 command started in services/data-acquisition but attempted to resolve services/data-acquisition again, so it stopped before compilation or any test began.

correction.action: Removed the duplicate path resolution and reran the harness from the declared service working directory.

events.schema_impact: None; no repository artifact was changed by the failed preflight.
events.quality_impact: Prevents a false test failure caused solely by the local harness working directory.

learning.reusable_lesson: Validation commands must resolve paths relative to their declared working directory exactly once.
learning.future_prevention: Print and validate the effective service root before beginning a complete corpus run.

events.observed_signal: The corrected path harness used system Python; four tests passed before Pattern Guided Explore stopped on missing BeautifulSoup rather than a repository regression.

correction.action: Selected the existing isolated Python 3.12 service environment with the pinned requirements and reran the entire corpus from the beginning.

events.schema_impact: None; dependencies and repository files were not installed or changed.
events.quality_impact: Establishes a valid exact-tree Level 3 result without conflating environment setup with product behavior.

learning.reusable_lesson: A deterministic corpus result is authoritative only under the service runtime with its declared dependencies.
learning.future_prevention: Resolve and verify the isolated service interpreter before running the first corpus test.

events.observed_signal: The first R55 coordination validation rejected the draft Result because Agent Handoff Result v1 requires a verification object with deterministic_tests_passed and live_request_count.

correction.action: Added the required fail-closed verification object to R55 and scheduled complete bundle validation before submission.

events.schema_impact: No protocol schema changed; the Result now supplies the existing required verification fields.
events.quality_impact: Prevents submission of an incomplete closure Result while preserving the blocked outcome and exact provider accounting.

learning.reusable_lesson: A rich Result still must satisfy the small mandatory Agent Handoff core before bundle validation.
learning.future_prevention: Run validate_result_record and validate_queue_state before closing the correction journal and preparing the final coordination commit.
